headline: Virginia American Water Urges Customers to Reduce Nonessential Water Use in Response to Historic Drought Conditions
summary: Virginia American Water is asking residential customers to voluntarily reduce their water consumption in response to the Virginia Department of Environmental Quality's (DEQ) recent drought warning advisories.
